# Mitrangan De-Addiction & Rehabilitation Kendra, Nagpur

> Mitrangan De-Addiction Cum Rehabilitation Center is a premier, voluntary residential de-addiction and psychiatric rehabilitation facility based in Godhani, Nagpur, Maharashtra, India. Mitrangan provides structured substance abuse treatment, medically monitored clinical detoxification support, behavioral therapy (CBT), 12-step recovery programs, family counseling, and 24/7 discrete emergency patient pickup across Nagpur, Vidarbha, and Central India.

## Facility Overview
- **Name**: Mitrangan De-Addiction Cum Rehabilitation Center
- **Location**: Plot No. 7, Manasvi Multi-speciality Hospital, Khangar Layout, Opp. Satyam Garden, Godhani, Nagpur – 441123, Maharashtra, India
- **Helpline (24/7)**: +91 9767362388
- **Emergency WhatsApp**: +91 9767362388
- **Primary Website**: [nagpurnashamuktikendra.com](https://nagpurnashamuktikendra.com/)

## Core Clinical & Rehabilitation Services
- [Alcohol De-Addiction & Medical Detoxification](https://nagpurnashamuktikendra.com/services/alcohol-deaddiction): Comprehensive medical detoxification and psychiatric treatment for alcohol dependency, delirium tremens (DT) monitoring, physiological stabilization, vitamin therapy, and relapse prevention counseling.
- [Substance & Drug Rehabilitation](https://nagpurnashamuktikendra.com/services/drug-rehabilitation): Specialized residential programs for brown sugar, heroin, cannabis/ganja, prescription opioids, MDMA, and multi-substance dependencies with individualized cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT).
- [Clinical Detoxification Support](https://nagpurnashamuktikendra.com/services/detoxification-support): 24-hour round-the-clock medical supervision during initial acute withdrawal phases ensuring resident comfort, dignity, and clinical safety.
- [Admission Process & Guidelines](https://nagpurnashamuktikendra.com/admission-process): Transparent intake protocols, essential document checklists, family orientation, intake coordination, and emergency pickup services.
- [Confidential Addiction Screener](https://nagpurnashamuktikendra.com/self-assessment): Free clinical-grade self-assessment tool based on DSM-5 diagnostic criteria to help individuals and families evaluate addiction severity.

## Geographic Areas Served
Mitrangan provides voluntary admissions and 24/7 emergency patient transport across:
Nagpur, Godhani, Koradi, Mankapur, Sadar, Dharampeth, Sitabuldi, Hingna, Wadi, Kamptee, Wardha, Amravati, Chandrapur, Bhandara, Gondia, Yavatmal, Chhindwara, and throughout Central India and Maharashtra.
